questions.question: Tom has 18 oranges. Mary has 17 oranges. How many oranges do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Nobody loses oranges in this story, so Tom's 18 and Mary's 17 go into a single pile and get added.
questions.questionZh: 汤姆有18个橙子。玛丽有17个橙子。他们一共有多少个橙子？
questions.hintZh: 这个故事里没有人失去橙子，所以把 Tom 的 18 个和 Mary 的 17 个合成一堆相加。

questions.question: Peter has 24 stickers. Jane has 9 stickers more than him. How many stickers do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Jane's amount is not given directly: build it from Peter's 24 plus the extra 9, then combine both children's stickers.
questions.questionZh: 彼得有24张贴纸。简比他多9张贴纸。他们一共有多少张贴纸？
questions.hintZh: Jane 的数量没有直接给出：先用 Peter 的 24 张加上多出的 9 张，再把 2 人的贴纸合起来。

questions.question: Mr Adam has some eggs. He sells 24 eggs in the morning and 10 eggs in the afternoon. He has 25 eggs left. How many eggs does he have at first?
questions.hint: Work backwards. The starting pile is made of the 24 sold in the morning, the 10 sold in the afternoon and the 25 still unsold.
questions.questionZh: 亚当先生有一些鸡蛋。他早上卖了24个，下午卖了10个，还剩25个。开始时他有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 倒过来想。一开始的鸡蛋数由上午卖掉的 24 个、下午卖掉的 10 个和还剩的 25 个组成。

questions.question: There are 8 boys and 6 girls in class A and 12 students in class B. How many students are there in the 2 classes?
questions.hint: Class A's size is not handed to you as a single number — add its boys and its girls, then bring in class B's 12 students.
questions.questionZh: A班有8名男生和6名女生，B班有12名学生。2个班一共有多少名学生？
questions.hintZh: A 班的人数没有直接给出——先把 8 个男生和 6 个女生相加，再加上 B 班的 12 人。

questions.question: Peter has some paperclips. He uses 15 of them and gives 6 paperclips to his sister. He has 17 paperclips left. How many paperclips does he have at first?
questions.hint: Rebuild the starting amount: the 15 used, the 6 given to his sister and the 17 remaining were all part of it.
questions.questionZh: 彼得有一些回形针。他用了15个，并给了妹妹6个，还剩17个。开始时他有多少个回形针？
questions.hintZh: 还原一开始的数量：用掉的 15 个、送给妹妹的 6 个和剩下的 17 个原本都属于它。

questions.question: Tom has 28 balloons. Jim has 23 balloons more than him. How many balloons do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Work out Jim's balloons before anything else — he holds Tom's 28 plus another 23. Only then put the 2 boys' balloons together.
questions.questionZh: 汤姆有28个气球。吉姆比他多23个气球。他们一共有多少个气球？
questions.hintZh: 先求出 Jim 的气球：他有 Tom 的 28 个再加 23 个。之后才把 2 个男孩的气球合起来。

questions.question: Ann has some apples. She sells 28 apples and has 15 apples left. How many apples does she have at first?
questions.hint: The apples Ann sold were part of her starting count too, so join the 28 sold back onto the 15 still with her.
questions.questionZh: 安有一些苹果。她卖出28个苹果后还剩15个。开始时她有多少个苹果？
questions.hintZh: Ann 卖掉的苹果原本也属于她一开始的总数，所以把卖掉的 28 个加回还剩的 15 个。

questions.question: John buys 21 yellow paperclips and 10 more green paperclips than yellow paperclips. Sean buys 15 paperclips more than John. How many paperclips does Sean buy?
questions.hint: 3 stages hide in here: green clips are 10 more than the 21 yellow ones, John's total is both colours together, and Sean sits 15 above that total.
questions.questionZh: 约翰买了21个黄色回形针，绿色回形针比黄色回形针多10个。肖恩比约翰多买15个回形针。肖恩买了多少个回形针？
questions.hintZh: 这里藏着 3 个步骤：绿色回形针比黄色的 21 个多 10 个，John 的总数是 2 种颜色相加，而 Sean 比这个总数还多 15 个。

questions.question: There are 11 green balls in a basket. Peter puts 15 orange balls and 21 purple balls into the basket. How many balls are there in the basket altogether?
questions.hint: The basket only grows: begin from the 11 already inside it and add each colour Peter drops in.
questions.questionZh: 篮子里有11个绿球。彼得又把15个橙球和21个紫球放进篮子里。篮子里一共有多少个球？
questions.hintZh: 篮子里的球只增不减：从原有的 11 个绿球开始，把 Peter 放进去的每种颜色都加上。

questions.question: A florist sells 26 orchids, 32 carnations and 18 roses. How many flowers does she sell altogether?
questions.hint: All 3 kinds of bloom count as sales, so the orchids, carnations and roses belong in the same sum.
questions.questionZh: 一位花店老板卖出26枝兰花、32枝康乃馨和18枝玫瑰。她一共卖出多少枝花？
questions.hintZh: 3 种花都算卖出，所以兰花、康乃馨和玫瑰要放在同一个加法里。

questions.question: There are 9 apples in a basket. Another 12 red apples and 16 green apples are put into the basket. How many apples are there altogether?
questions.hint: Do not forget the 9 apples sitting in the basket before the red and green apples arrive; all 3 groups belong in the total.
questions.questionZh: 篮子里有9个苹果。又往篮子里放入12个红苹果和16个绿苹果。一共有多少个苹果？
questions.hintZh: 别忘了红苹果和绿苹果放进去之前，篮子里已经有 9 个；3 组都要算进总数。

questions.question: Jack sells 24 charity tickets. He sells 17 charity tickets fewer than Mary. How many charity tickets do they sell altogether?
questions.hint: Mind the direction: Mary sold more, so her count is Jack's 24 raised by 17. Add the pair only after that.
questions.questionZh: 杰克卖出24张慈善票券。他比玛丽少卖17张慈善票券。他们一共卖出多少张慈善票券？
questions.hintZh: 注意方向：Mary 卖得更多，所以她的数量是 Jack 的 24 张再加 17 张。之后才把 2 人相加。

questions.question: A shirt costs $41. 1 pair of pants costs $12 more than the shirt. How much do the shirt and the pair of pants cost altogether?
questions.hint: Price the pants against the shirt, $41 plus $12. The question then wants both garments added.
questions.questionZh: 一件衬衫售价$41。1条裤子比这件衬衫贵$12。这件衬衫和这条裤子一共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先以衬衫为基准算裤子的价钱，$41 加 $12。然后题目要的是 2 件衣物的价钱相加。

questions.question: 1 magazine costs $5 more than 1 book. The magazine costs $9. What is the cost of 3 such books?
questions.hint: Undo the comparison to price a single book: take $5 off the magazine's $9. That price then repeats 3 times.
questions.questionZh: 1本杂志的价格比1本书高$5。这本杂志售价$9。3本这样的书共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 反过来求 1 本书的价钱：用杂志的 $9 减去 $5。这个价钱再重复 3 次。

questions.question: Jack has 26 balloons. Linda has 55 balloons. How many more balloons must Jack buy so that he will have the same number of balloons as Linda?
questions.hint: Jack is catching up, so ask how far short of Linda's 55 balloons his 26 leaves him — that shortfall is what he must buy.
questions.questionZh: 杰克有26个气球。琳达有55个气球。杰克还要买多少个气球，才能和琳达拥有一样多的气球？
questions.hintZh: Jack 要追上 Linda，所以想一想他的 26 个离 Linda 的 55 个还差多少——差的部分就是他要买的。

questions.question: When a number is subtracted from another, the answer is 12. If the bigger number is 17, what is the smaller number?
questions.hint: The gap of 12 sits between the 2 numbers, so peel that gap off the bigger number, 17, to land on the smaller.
questions.questionZh: 一个数减去另一个数，差是12。如果较大的数是17，较小的数是多少？
questions.hintZh: 12 是这 2 个数之间的差距，所以从较大的数 17 里去掉这个差距，就得到较小的数。

questions.question: Mr Cook buys 17 tickets for a concert. He gives 5 tickets to his friends and uses the rest of the tickets to take his family to the concert. How many people are there in Mr Cook's family?
questions.hint: The tickets he keeps are the family's seats, so remove the 5 gifts from the 17 bought, counting 1 ticket per person.
questions.questionZh: 库克先生买了17张音乐会门票。他给朋友5张，其余门票用来带家人去听音乐会。库克先生家里有多少人？
questions.hintZh: 他留下的票就是家人的座位，所以从买的 17 张里去掉送出的 5 张，每人 1 张票。

questions.question: Alice has 23 stamps. She gives her mother 15 stamps. How many stamps does she have in the end?
questions.hint: Stamps leave Alice's collection here, so the 15 she hands over come off her 23.
questions.questionZh: 爱丽丝有23枚邮票。她给妈妈15枚邮票。最后她有多少枚邮票？
questions.hintZh: 邮票从 Alice 的收藏里减少，所以送出的 15 张要从她的 23 张里减掉。

questions.question: 13 more than a number is 38. What is the number?
questions.hint: Treat it as a small puzzle: a hidden number grew by 13 and reached 38, so undo that growth.
questions.questionZh: 一个数加上13等于38。这个数是多少？
questions.hintZh: 把它当成一个小谜题：某个隐藏的数增加 13 后变成 38，所以要把这次增加倒回去。

questions.question: There are 72 people at a party. 20 of them are children and the rest are adults. How many more adults than children are there?
questions.hint: You cannot compare until you know the adults, so lift the 20 children out of the 72 guests, then measure that group against the children.
questions.questionZh: 一次聚会上有72人。其中20人是儿童，其余是成人。成人比儿童多多少人？
questions.hintZh: 不知道大人的人数就无法比较，所以先从 72 人里去掉 20 个小孩，再把大人和小孩比较。

questions.question: There are 38 soldiers in a field. 15 of them wear green uniforms and the rest wear brown uniforms. How many more soldiers wear brown uniforms than green uniforms?
questions.hint: The brown-uniform group is unknown, so take the green-uniform soldiers out of the whole field, and only then find the gap between the 2 groups.
questions.questionZh: 一片场地上有38名士兵。其中15人穿绿色制服，其余人穿棕色制服。穿棕色制服的士兵比穿绿色制服的士兵多多少人？
questions.hintZh: 穿棕色制服的人数未知，所以先从全部士兵中减去穿绿色制服的，再求这 2 组之间的差距。

questions.question: When 2 numbers are added together, the answer is 30. If 1 of the numbers is 12, what is the other number?
questions.hint: Adding can be undone: the total of 30 already holds the 12 inside it, so remove that part to expose its partner.
questions.questionZh: 2个数相加等于30。如果其中1个数是12，另一个数是多少？
questions.hintZh: 加法可以倒过来：总数 30 里已经包含了 12，把这部分拿走就露出另一个数。

questions.question: A watch and a clock cost $68 at a sale. The watch costs $39. How much more does the watch cost than the clock?
questions.hint: The clock's price hides inside the $68 pair — subtract the watch's $39 to uncover it, then compare the 2 prices.
questions.questionZh: 促销时，一块手表和一座时钟共售$68。手表售价$39。手表比时钟贵多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 钟的价钱藏在 $68 的总价里——减去手表的 $39 就能求出，然后比较这 2 件的价钱。

questions.question: Jim has $80. Linda has $36. How much more money does Jim have than Linda?
questions.hint: A 'how much more' question wants a difference: set Jim's $80 beside Linda's $36 and subtract the smaller amount.
questions.questionZh: 吉姆有$80。琳达有$36。吉姆比琳达多多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 「多多少」问的是差额：把 Jim 的 $80 和 Linda 的 $36 摆在一起，减去较小的金额。

questions.question: Mary buys a toaster for $38. She gives the cashier $50. How much change does she get?
questions.hint: Change is whatever survives of the $50 once the shop keeps the toaster's $38 price.
questions.questionZh: 玛丽花$38买了烤面包机。她给收银员$50。她能找回多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 找零就是 $50 中付掉烤面包机的 $38 之后剩下的部分。

questions.question: Tim has $95. He spends $26 and saves the rest of his money. How much does he save?
questions.hint: Savings are just the leftover, so the $26 Tim spent has to come off his $95.
questions.questionZh: 蒂姆有$95。他花了$26，其余的钱存起来。他存了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 存下的就是剩余部分，所以 Tim 花掉的 $26 要从他的 $95 里减掉。

questions.question: There are 8 boy scouts in a group. Each boy scout has 3 badges. How many badges do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Every scout wears the same 3 badges, so that group of badges repeats across all 8 scouts — a multiplication, not an addition of unequal parts.
questions.questionZh: 一组中有8名童子军。每名童子军有3枚徽章。他们一共有多少枚徽章？
questions.hintZh: 每个童军都有同样的 3 枚徽章，所以这一组徽章要在 8 个童军身上重复——用乘法，而不是把不相等的部分相加。

questions.question: Peter drinks 2 glasses of milk each day. How many glasses of milk does he drink in 1 week?
questions.hint: Turn the week into days before you calculate: a week runs for 7 days, and Peter repeats his 2 glasses on every single day.
questions.questionZh: 彼得每天喝2杯牛奶。他在1周内喝多少杯牛奶？
questions.hintZh: 先把「1 周」换成天数：1 周有 7 天，而 Peter 每天都重复喝 2 杯。

questions.question: Alice puts 8 stamps on every page of her stamp album. There are 5 pages in her album. How many stamps does she have altogether?
questions.hint: Each page carries an equal group of 8 stamps, so scale that group up by the 5 pages in the album.
questions.questionZh: 爱丽丝在集邮册的每一页上放8枚邮票。她的集邮册有5页。她一共有多少枚邮票？
questions.hintZh: 每一页都是相同的 8 枚一组，所以把这一组按册子里的 5 页放大。

questions.question: There are 6 flowers in a bouquet. Betty buys 3 such bouquets. How many flowers does she buy altogether?
questions.hint: Betty buys identical bundles, so take the 6 flowers in 1 bouquet and repeat that bundle 3 times.
questions.questionZh: 一束花有6朵。贝蒂买了3束这样的花。她一共买了多少朵花？
questions.hintZh: Betty 买的是一样的花束，所以把 1 束里的 6 朵重复 3 次。

questions.question: Mrs Wood bakes 18 cakes. She puts them equally into 3 boxes. How many cakes are there in each box?
questions.hint: Sharing equally means splitting, not taking away: cut the 18 cakes into 3 matching portions.
questions.questionZh: 伍德太太烤了18个蛋糕。她把它们平均放进3个盒子里。每个盒子里有多少个蛋糕？
questions.hintZh: 平均分是分割而不是减法：把 18 个蛋糕切成 3 等份。

questions.question: Andrew reads 4 pages of a book each day. How many days will he take to finish reading a 32-page book?
questions.hint: Ask how many groups of 4 pages fit inside the 32 pages, because each group is a day of reading.
questions.questionZh: 安德鲁每天读4页书。他读完一本32页的书需要多少天？
questions.hintZh: 想一想 32 页里能装下多少组 4 页，因为每一组就是 1 天的阅读量。

questions.question: Mr Cook buys 12 eggs. He puts them equally into 4 bags. How many eggs are there in each bag?
questions.hint: The eggs are spread out evenly, so the 12 must break into 4 equal shares, with a share for each bag.
questions.questionZh: 库克先生买了12个鸡蛋。他把它们平均装进4个袋子里。每个袋子里有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 鸡蛋是平均放进去的，所以 12 个要分成 4 等份，每个袋子放 1 份。

questions.question: 1 packet of tomatoes costs $2. Mrs Fay has $10. How many packets of tomatoes can she buy with all her money?
questions.hint: Count how many $2 chunks her $10 can be broken into; each chunk pays for a packet.
questions.questionZh: 1包番茄售价$2。费伊太太有$10。她把所有的钱都用来买番茄，能买多少包？
questions.hintZh: 数一数她的 $10 能分成多少个 $2；每一份正好买 1 包。

questions.question: Mrs Drew buys 30 sweets. She gives 12 sweets to her daughter and 15 sweets to her son. How many sweets has she left?
questions.hint: Add up everything Mrs Drew gives away before you touch her starting pile. Then take that gift total off what she began with.
questions.questionZh: 德鲁太太买了30颗糖。她给女儿12颗糖，给儿子15颗糖。她还剩多少颗糖？
questions.hintZh: 先把送给女儿和儿子的糖果加起来，再从她原有的糖果里减去这个总数。

questions.question: There are 22 flowers in a vase. 9 of them are red, 6 are yellow and the rest are pink. How many pink flowers are there in the vase?
questions.hint: Red and yellow together make 1 known group. Pink is whatever the vase still holds after that group is taken from 22.
questions.questionZh: 花瓶里有22朵花。其中9朵是红色，6朵是黄色，其余是粉红色。花瓶里有多少朵粉红色的花？
questions.hintZh: 先把红花和黄花合成一组已知的花，再用 22 减去这一组，剩下的就是粉花。

questions.question: Mrs Jones bakes 35 cookies. There are 8 butter cookies, some chocolate chip cookies and 12 coconut cookies. How many chocolate chip cookies does she bake?
questions.hint: The butter and coconut batches are the part you already know, so combine them. Then see how much of the 35 is still unaccounted for.
questions.questionZh: 琼斯太太烤了35块饼干。其中有8块黄油饼干、一些巧克力豆饼干和12块椰子饼干。她烤了多少块巧克力豆饼干？
questions.hintZh: 牛油饼干和椰子饼干是已知的那部分，先把它们合起来，再看 35 块里还剩多少没算。

questions.question: Mrs Drew bakes 16 apple pies and 28 lemon pies on Monday. On Tuesday, she bakes 12 lemon pies. How many more lemon pies than apple pies does she bake in the end?
questions.hint: Lemon pies were baked on 2 separate days, so total them before you compare anything. Only then set the lemon count against the single apple count.
questions.questionZh: 德鲁太太星期一烤了16个苹果派和28个柠檬派。星期二她又烤了12个柠檬派。最后她烤的柠檬派比苹果派多多少个？
questions.hintZh: 柠檬派是分 2 天做的，要先把两天的柠檬派加起来，再拿它跟苹果派的数量比较。

questions.question: There are 20 boys and 10 girls in class A. There are 18 boys and 24 girls in class B. How many fewer girls than boys are there in both classes altogether?
questions.hint: Pool the boys from both classes, then pool the girls, before you compare. The 2 classes lean opposite ways, so 1 gap cancels part of the other.
questions.questionZh: A班有20名男生和10名女生。B班有18名男生和24名女生。两个班合起来，女生比男生少多少名？
questions.hintZh: 先把 2 个班的男生合起来，再把女生合起来，然后才比较。2 个班的偏向相反，所以 1 边的差会抵消另一边的一部分。

questions.question: There are 34 peanuts and 12 walnuts on a plate. After Tom has eaten some of the nuts, there are 17 nuts left. How many nuts does Tom eat?
questions.hint: Both kinds of nut sit on the same plate, so build the starting total before anything else. What Tom ate is the drop from that total down to 17.
questions.questionZh: 盘子里有34颗花生和12颗核桃。汤姆吃了一些坚果后，还剩17颗坚果。汤姆吃了多少颗坚果？
questions.hintZh: 两种坚果在同一个盘子里，要先算出一开始的总数，Tom 吃掉的就是这个总数与 17 之间的差。

questions.question: Joe has some marbles. He receives 18 marbles from his father and 13 marbles from his brother. He has 40 marbles in the end. How many marbles does he have at first?
questions.hint: Both gifts landed on top of a start he already had, so add the gifts into a single lump. Peel that lump off the 40 to rewind to where he began.
questions.questionZh: 乔有一些弹珠。他从爸爸那里得到18颗弹珠，又从哥哥那里得到13颗弹珠。最后他有40颗弹珠。开始时他有多少颗弹珠？
questions.hintZh: 两份礼物都是加在他原有的弹珠上的，先把礼物合成一份，再从 40 颗里减掉，就回到他一开始的数量。

questions.question: When 12 is added to a number, the result is 2 more than 31. What is the number?
questions.hint: Work out what the result actually equals before anything else - it sits 2 above 31. Then undo the 12 that was added to reach it.
questions.questionZh: 12加上一个数，结果比31多2。这个数是多少？
questions.hintZh: 先算出结果究竟是多少，它比 31 多 2；然后再把加上去的 12 还原减掉。

questions.question: A farmer has 34 eggs. He throws away 8 rotten eggs and sells 7 eggs. He keeps the rest. How many more eggs does he keep than sell?
questions.hint: The eggs he throws away and the eggs he sells both leave the 34, so clear them out to find the kept pile. Then compare that kept pile with the eggs he sold.
questions.questionZh: 一位农夫有34个鸡蛋。他扔掉8个坏鸡蛋，卖出7个鸡蛋，其余的留下。留下的鸡蛋比卖出的多多少个？
questions.hintZh: 坏掉的和卖掉的鸡蛋都要从 34 个里去掉，先算出留下的数量，再把它和卖掉的鸡蛋相比。

questions.question: There are 54 pages in a book. Mary reads 13 pages on Monday and 8 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are not read yet?
questions.hint: Mary's 2 reading days join into a single amount read. Subtract that from the whole book to see what is still waiting.
questions.questionZh: 一本书有54页。玛丽星期一读了13页，星期二读了8页。还有多少页没有读？
questions.hintZh: 把 Mary 两天读的页数合成一个数，再用整本书的页数减去它，就是还没读的部分。

questions.question: There are 18 boys and 21 girls in a field. A teacher has 31 balls. She gives each of them a ball. How many children will not have a ball?
questions.hint: Count every child in the field as 1 group, boys and girls together. The shortfall is how far the 31 balls fall below that group.
questions.questionZh: 场地上有18名男孩和21名女孩。一位老师有31个球。她给每个孩子一个球。有多少名孩子没有球？
questions.hintZh: 先把男孩和女孩合成一个孩子总数，31 个球比这个总数少多少，就是拿不到球的人数。

questions.question: Peter scores 45 points in a game. Alex scores 6 points fewer than him. How many points do they score altogether?
questions.hint: Alex's score is not handed to you - build it from Peter's by removing the gap between them. Then put the 2 scores together.
questions.questionZh: 彼得在一场比赛中得了45分。亚历克斯比他少得6分。他们一共得了多少分？
questions.hintZh: Alex 的分数没有直接给出，要用 Peter 的分数减去两人的差距算出来，然后再把两人的分数相加。

questions.question: There are 26 batteries in a box. Thomas uses 7 batteries for his toy car and 12 batteries for a torch. How many batteries are left in the box?
questions.hint: The toy car batteries and the torch batteries both leave the box, so add those uses together. Take the result away from 26.
questions.questionZh: 盒子里有26节电池。托马斯的玩具车用了7节电池，手电筒用了12节电池。盒子里还剩多少节电池？
questions.hintZh: 玩具车和手电筒用掉的电池都离开了盒子，先把两处用掉的加起来，再从 26 节里减去。

questions.question: Jack, Anna and Tom have 70 marbles. Jack has 24 marbles. Anna has 12 marbles more than him. How many marbles does Tom have?
questions.hint: Anna's count must be built from Jack's before you can use it. Once Jack and Anna are added, Tom is the leftover of the 70.
questions.questionZh: 杰克、安娜和汤姆共有70颗弹珠。杰克有24颗弹珠。安娜比杰克多12颗弹珠。汤姆有多少颗弹珠？
questions.hintZh: 要先用 Jack 的数量算出 Anna 的数量，把 Jack 和 Anna 加起来后，Tom 就是 70 颗里剩下的部分。

questions.question: There are 38 roses in a vase. 12 of them are red, 10 are pink and the rest are white. How many white roses are there?
questions.hint: Red and pink are the roses you can already count, so join them into a part. White is what is missing from 38 after that part is removed.
questions.questionZh: 花瓶里有38枝玫瑰。其中12枝是红色，10枝是粉红色，其余是白色。白玫瑰有多少枝？
questions.hintZh: 红玫瑰和粉玫瑰是已经知道的，先合成一部分，白玫瑰就是 38 朵减去这部分之后剩下的。

questions.question: Mr Smith wants to buy 60 pieces of fruit. He buys 18 apples and 19 bananas at the market. How many more pieces of fruit does he need to buy?
questions.hint: Apples and bananas are already in his basket, so total what he has bought. The rest is the gap between that and the 60 he wants.
questions.questionZh: 史密斯先生想买60个水果。他在市场买了18个苹果和19根香蕉。他还需要买多少个水果？
questions.hintZh: 苹果和香蕉已经买了，先加起来算出已买的数量，还要买的就是它与 60 个之间的差。

questions.question: There are 26 boys and 15 girls in a class. 17 children wear spectacles. How many children do not wear spectacles?
questions.hint: The 17 spectacle wearers are counted out of the whole class, so work out the class size before you subtract.
questions.questionZh: 一个班有26名男生和15名女生，其中17名儿童戴眼镜。不戴眼镜的儿童有多少名？
questions.hintZh: 戴眼镜的 17 人是从全班里数出来的，所以要先算出全班有多少人，再做减法。

questions.question: Mrs Owen has 20 cookies. She gives 7 cookies each to her 2 friends. How many cookies has she left?
questions.hint: Each friend gets the same amount, so double a friend's share to find the giveaway. Take that away from her 20 cookies.
questions.questionZh: 欧文太太有20块饼干。她给2位朋友每人7块饼干。她还剩多少块饼干？
questions.hintZh: 每位朋友拿到的一样多，先算出 2 位朋友一共拿走多少，再从她的 20 块里减去。

questions.question: Jane has 35 stickers. She gives 12 stickers to Sam. William gives Jane 13 stickers. How many stickers does Jane have in the end?
questions.hint: Follow the stickers in order: 1st the pile shrinks when Sam is given some, then it grows again when William hands some over.
questions.questionZh: 简有35张贴纸。她给萨姆12张贴纸。威廉又给简13张贴纸。最后简有多少张贴纸？
questions.hintZh: 按顺序跟着贴纸走：先给 Sam 之后数量变少，接着 William 又给她，数量再变多。

questions.question: There are 45 books on a shelf. 12 of them are English books, 7 are science books and the rest are mathematics books. How many mathematics books are there?
questions.hint: English and science books form the part of the shelf you know. Strip that combined part off the 45 to leave the mathematics books.
questions.questionZh: 书架上有45本书。其中12本是英语书，7本是科学书，其余是数学书。数学书有多少本？
questions.hintZh: 英文书和科学书是书架上已知的部分，先加起来，再从 45 本里减掉，剩下的就是数学书。

questions.question: There are 54 pink ribbons in a box. There are 15 fewer red ribbons than pink ribbons in the box. How many ribbons are there altogether?
questions.hint: The red count is hidden behind a comparison, so get it from the pink count by taking the stated gap away. Only then add the 2 colours.
questions.questionZh: 盒子里有54条粉红色丝带。红丝带比粉红色丝带少15条。盒子里一共有多少条丝带？
questions.hintZh: 红丝带的数量藏在比较里，要用粉丝带的数量减去题目给的差算出来，然后再把两种颜色加起来。

questions.question: There are 40 fish in a tank. 16 of them are orange, 11 are red and the rest are white. How many white fish are there?
questions.hint: Add the orange and red fish into a single coloured group. Subtract that group from the 40 in the tank to leave the white fish.
questions.questionZh: 鱼缸里有40条鱼。其中16条是橙色，11条是红色，其余是白色。白鱼有多少条？
questions.hintZh: 先把橙色和红色的鱼合成一组，再用鱼缸里的 40 条减去这一组，剩下的就是白色的鱼。

questions.question: There are 26 red apples and 12 green apples in box A. There are 20 red apples and 10 green apples in box B. How many more apples are there in box A than in box B?
questions.hint: Each box needs its own total of red plus green apples before any comparison happens. Set box A's total against box B's total after that.
questions.questionZh: A盒里有26个红苹果和12个绿苹果。B盒里有20个红苹果和10个绿苹果。A盒比B盒多多少个苹果？
questions.hintZh: 每个盒子都要先把红苹果和绿苹果加起来算出自己的总数，然后再比较 A 盒和 B 盒的总数。

questions.question: Joel has some toy cars. His mother gives him 18 toy cars and his father gives him another 8 toy cars. He has 41 toy cars altogether. How many toy cars does he have at first?
questions.hint: Mother's and father's cars both arrived after the start, so bundle the 2 gifts. Removing that bundle from 41 rewinds him to the start.
questions.questionZh: 乔尔有一些玩具车。他的妈妈给了他18辆，爸爸又给了他8辆。他一共有41辆玩具车。开始时他有多少辆玩具车？
questions.hintZh: 妈妈和爸爸送的车都是后来加上的，先把这 2 份礼物合起来，再从 41 辆里减掉，就退回到最初的数量。

questions.question: Peter has $20. He spends $4 on Monday and $8 on Tuesday. How much has he left?
questions.hint: Add Monday's spending to Tuesday's so you know the whole amount that left his pocket. Then subtract it from his $20.
questions.questionZh: 彼得有$20。他星期一花了$4，星期二花了$8。他还剩多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 先把周一和周二花的钱加起来，得出一共花了多少，再从他的 $20 里减去。

questions.question: Tom has 28 toy aeroplanes. 12 of them are red, 5 are green and the rest are blue. How many more blue toy aeroplanes than green toy aeroplanes does he have?
questions.hint: The blue planes are never given, so clear the red and green planes out of the 28 to find them. Then set blue against green.
questions.questionZh: 汤姆有28架玩具飞机。其中12架是红色，5架是绿色，其余是蓝色。他的蓝色玩具飞机比绿色玩具飞机多多少架？
questions.hintZh: 蓝色飞机的数量没有直接给出，要先从 28 架里去掉红色和绿色的，再拿蓝色和绿色相比。

questions.question: There are 35 adults and 28 children at a party. After 3 men and 17 girls leave the party, how many people are left at the party?
questions.hint: The men and girls who leave are just parts of the adults and children already counted, so make a party total and a leaving total. Subtract the smaller from the bigger.
questions.questionZh: 一次聚会上有35名成人和28名儿童。3名男子和17名女孩离开后，聚会上还剩多少人？
questions.hintZh: 离开的男人和女孩都属于已经数过的大人和小孩，所以先算出派对上的总人数和离开的总人数，再相减。

questions.question: A dinner costs $100. Mr William pays $35, Mr Jackson pays $40 and Mr Lee pays the rest. How much does Mr Lee pay?
questions.hint: Mr William's and Mr Jackson's shares cover part of the bill, so pool them. Mr Lee covers whatever the $100 still lacks.
questions.questionZh: 一顿晚餐花费$100。威廉先生付了$35，杰克逊先生付了$40，李先生付其余的钱。李先生付了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: William 先生和 Jackson 先生付的钱先加在一起，$100 还差的部分就是 Lee 先生要付的。

questions.question: There are 80 students in an art competition. 15 of them are in Primary 1, 12 are in Primary 2 and the rest are in Primary 3. What is the total number of Primary 1 and Primary 3 students in the competition?
questions.hint: Find the Primary 3 group by clearing the 2 known year groups out of the 80, then add the Primary 1 group back on.
questions.questionZh: 一次美术比赛有80名学生。其中15名是小学1年级学生，12名是小学2年级学生，其余是小学3年级学生。比赛中小学1年级和小学3年级学生一共有多少名？
questions.hintZh: 先从 80 人里减去已知的两个年级，算出三年级的人数，再把一年级的人数加回去。

questions.question: Ben has $30. He spends $5 on food, $9 on books and some on stationery. He has $8 left. How much does he spend on stationery?
questions.hint: The food, the books and the cash still in his pocket all come out of the same $30. Whatever those 3 amounts leave unclaimed is the spending the question asks about.
questions.questionZh: 本有$30。他买食物花了$5，买书花了$9，还花了一些钱买文具。他还剩$8。他买文具花了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 食物、书本的花费和口袋里剩下的钱都来自同一笔 $30，把这 3 部分去掉后，剩下的就是文具的花费。

questions.question: John has $7. Betty has $2 more than John. Peter has $6 less than Betty. How much do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Betty's amount grows out of John's, and Peter's is then measured down from Betty's. Build them along that chain before adding all 3.
questions.questionZh: 约翰有$7。贝蒂比约翰多$2。彼得比贝蒂少$6。他们一共有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: Betty 的钱由 John 的算出，Peter 的钱再由 Betty 的减出，按这个顺序算好后，再把 3 个人的钱加起来。

questions.question: An apple costs 60 cents. An orange costs 20 cents less than the apple. A pear costs 40 cents more than the orange. How much does the pear cost?
questions.hint: The pear is described from the orange, and the orange from the apple, so travel that chain in order starting at the 60 cents.
questions.questionZh: 苹果售价60美分。橙子比苹果便宜20美分。梨比橙子贵40美分。梨售价多少美分？
questions.hintZh: 梨的价钱由橙子说出，橙子的价钱又由苹果说出，所以要从 60 分开始，按这条链子一步步往下算。

questions.question: A dress costs $24. It costs $16 more than a blouse. What is the total cost of the dress and the blouse?
questions.hint: The dress is the pricier item, so the blouse comes from taking the stated $16 gap off $24. Add the 2 prices once you have both.
questions.questionZh: 一条连衣裙售价$24。它比一件女衬衫贵$16。这条连衣裙和这件女衬衫一共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 连衣裙比较贵，所以要用 $24 减去 $16 的差价算出衬衫的价钱，两件都算出来后再相加。

questions.question: There are 46 orchids in a vase. There are 28 more orchids than roses in the vase. How many flowers are there altogether?
questions.hint: Roses fall short of the orchids by the stated gap, so subtract to uncover the rose count. Altogether then means both kinds of flower added.
questions.questionZh: 花瓶里有46枝兰花。兰花比玫瑰多28枝。花瓶里一共有多少枝花？
questions.hintZh: 玫瑰比兰花少，少的数量就是题目给的差，先减出玫瑰的数量，再把两种花加起来。

questions.question: A photo album contains 24 photographs. Jack takes out 8 photographs and puts in 15 new ones. How many photographs are in the photo album in the end?
questions.hint: Jack takes some photographs out and puts more in, so subtract the 8 removed from 24 as the 1st step, then add the 15 new photographs.
questions.questionZh: 一个相册里有24张照片。杰克取出8张照片，再放入15张新照片。最后相册里有多少张照片？
questions.hintZh: 他先拿走再放入，所以先用 24 减去拿走的 8 张，再加上放进去的 15 张。

questions.question: There are 14 pink flowers and 12 red flowers in a shop. 7 flowers are sold. How many flowers are left?
questions.hint: Both colours sit in the same shop, so add the 14 pink and the 12 red into a single total before taking away the 7 that are sold.
questions.questionZh: 一家商店里有14朵粉红色的花和12朵红色的花。卖出7朵花后，还剩多少朵花？
questions.hintZh: 2 种花放在一起，先把 14 朵和 12 朵加起来求总数，再减去卖掉的 7 朵。

questions.question: There are 3 red pens and 2 blue pens in a box. How many pens are there in 5 such boxes?
questions.hint: Work out how many pens fill 1 box by adding the red and the blue, then multiply that box amount by the 5 boxes.
questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有3支红色钢笔和2支蓝色钢笔。5个这样的盒子里一共有多少支钢笔？
questions.hintZh: 先把红笔和蓝笔加起来，算出 1 盒有几支，再乘以 5 盒。

questions.question: Mrs Rice has 3 boxes of cookies. There are 5 cookies in each box. Her friend gives her another 12 cookies. How many cookies does Mrs Rice have altogether?
questions.hint: The boxes are equal groups, so multiply before you add: find the cookies inside the boxes, then add the gift of 12.
questions.questionZh: 赖斯太太有3盒饼干，每盒有5块。她的朋友又给她12块饼干。赖斯太太一共有多少块饼干？
questions.hintZh: 几盒饼干是相同的组，先乘后加：先算出 3 盒里的饼干，再加上朋友送的 12 块。

questions.question: In a hall, there are 3 rows of children. There are 7 children in each row. Another 5 children arrive at the hall. How many children are there altogether?
questions.hint: Rows are equal groups, so multiply the rows by the children in each row, and only then add the children who arrive later.
questions.questionZh: 大厅里有3排儿童，每排有7名儿童。又有5名儿童来到大厅。大厅里一共有多少名儿童？
questions.hintZh: 每排人数相同，先用排数乘每排的人数，再加上后来到的 5 人。

questions.question: There are 4 bags of oranges. Each bag has 8 oranges. There are 3 bags of apples. Each bag has 5 apples. How many pieces of fruit are there altogether?
questions.hint: This story hides 2 separate groups. Multiply for the oranges, multiply for the apples, then add those results.
questions.questionZh: 有4袋橙子，每袋有8个橙子。有3袋苹果，每袋有5个苹果。一共有多少个水果？
questions.hintZh: 橙子和苹果是 2 组，分别乘出各自的数量，再把 2 个结果相加。

questions.question: Mr Baker buys some eggs. He cooks 12 of them, throws away 6 rotten ones and packs the rest into 2 bags. Each bag has 3 eggs. How many eggs does he have at first?
questions.hint: Work backwards. Multiply to find the eggs that went into the bags, then add back the eggs he cooked and the spoilt eggs he threw away.
questions.questionZh: 贝克先生买了一些鸡蛋。他煮了12个，扔掉6个坏鸡蛋，把剩下的装进2个袋子里。每个袋子里有3个鸡蛋。开始时他有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 倒着想：先乘出装进袋子的鸡蛋数，再加回煮掉的 12 个和丢掉的 6 个。

questions.question: There are 5 blue crayons and 6 purple crayons in a box. There are 3 boxes. How many crayons are there altogether?
questions.hint: Every box holds the same mix, so add the blue and the purple crayons for 1 box, then multiply by the number of boxes.
questions.questionZh: 一个盒子里有5支蓝色蜡笔和6支紫色蜡笔。有3个这样的盒子。一共有多少支蜡笔？
questions.hintZh: 每盒装的一样多，先把蓝色和紫色加起来求 1 盒的数量，再乘以盒数。

questions.question: Mr Bell has 18 apples. He shares the apples equally with his 2 friends. How many apples does each of them get?
questions.hint: Count the people sharing: Mr Bell and his friends together. Divide the apples by that many people, not by the number of friends.
questions.questionZh: 贝尔先生有18个苹果。他和2位朋友平分这些苹果。每人能分到多少个苹果？
questions.hintZh: 分苹果的人包括贝尔先生自己和他的朋友，先数清一共几个人，再用苹果数除以人数。

questions.question: Ben has 8 coins. Lucy has 4 coins. They divide their coins equally between themselves. How many coins does each of them get?
questions.hint: Put both children's coins into 1 pile by adding, then divide that pile equally between them.
questions.questionZh: 本有8枚硬币。露西有4枚硬币。他们把硬币合在一起平分。每人有多少枚硬币？
questions.hintZh: 先把 2 人的硬币合成一堆加起来，再把这堆平均分给他们 2 个人。

questions.question: There are 12 chicken eggs and 6 quail eggs in a basket. All the eggs are packed equally into 3 packets. How many eggs are there in each packet?
questions.hint: The basket holds 2 kinds of eggs, so find the whole basket total before you split it equally among the 3 packets.
questions.questionZh: 篮子里有12个鸡蛋和6个鹌鹑蛋。所有鸡蛋平均装进3包。每包有多少个鸡蛋？
questions.hintZh: 篮子里有 2 种蛋，先算出全部蛋的总数，再平均分到 3 个袋子里。

questions.question: 2 books cost $10 and 3 pens cost $6. How much does Peter spend if he buys 1 book and 1 pen?
questions.hint: The prices are given for groups, so divide to get the cost of 1 book and the cost of 1 pen, then add those unit prices.
questions.questionZh: 2本书售价$10，3支笔售价$6。如果彼得买1本书和1支笔，他要花多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 题目给的是几本书、几支笔的价钱，先分别除出 1 本书和 1 支笔的单价，再把 2 个单价相加。

questions.question: There are 11 children in a room. 3 of them do not have hats. The rest of the children have 2 hats each. How many hats do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Not every child wears hats, so subtract to find how many children do have hats before you multiply by the hats each of them wears.
questions.questionZh: 一个房间里有11名儿童。其中3名没有帽子，其余儿童每人有2顶帽子。他们一共有多少顶帽子？
questions.hintZh: 有 3 个孩子没有帽子，先减出戴帽子的孩子人数，再乘以每人 2 顶。

questions.question: Janet buys 4 packets of balloons. There are 5 balloons in each packet. She uses 2 packets. How many balloons has she left?
questions.hint: Count the packets she still has by subtracting, then multiply that by the balloons inside each packet.
questions.questionZh: 珍妮特买了4包气球，每包有5个气球。她用了2包。她还剩多少个气球？
questions.hintZh: 先减出她还剩几包，再乘以每包 5 个气球。

questions.question: Mary has $15. She buys 1 chocolate cake and has $7 left. How much do 2 such chocolate cakes cost?
questions.hint: The cake price is the gap between what Mary had and what is left, so subtract for 1 cake, then multiply for 2 cakes.
questions.questionZh: 玛丽有$15。她买了1个巧克力蛋糕后还剩$7。2个这样的巧克力蛋糕共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 蛋糕的价钱等于 $15 减去剩下的 $7,先算出 1 个蛋糕多少钱，再乘以 2 个。

questions.question: Mr Brown has 4 bags. There are 9 oranges in each bag. He gives 15 oranges to his friend. How many oranges has he left?
questions.hint: Build the missing total as your 1st move: multiply the bags by the oranges in each, then take away what he gives to his friend.
questions.questionZh: 布朗先生有4袋橙子，每袋有9个橙子。他给朋友15个橙子。他还剩多少个橙子？
questions.hintZh: 先乘出 4 袋一共多少个橙子，再减去送给朋友的 15 个。

questions.question: 1 stalk of rose costs $5. A florist sells 3 stalks of roses and some stalks of orchids. She collects $27. How much money does she collect from selling the orchids?
questions.hint: Roses and orchids share the $27. Multiply to price the roses, then subtract that from everything she collects.
questions.questionZh: 1枝玫瑰售价$5。一位花店老板卖出3枝玫瑰和若干枝兰花，一共收了$27。她卖兰花收了多少钱？
questions.hintZh: $27 里包含玫瑰和兰花两部分，先乘出玫瑰卖了多少钱，再从总数中减掉。

questions.question: 2 chairs and 1 table cost $50. 1 chair costs $8. What is the cost of the table?
questions.hint: The $50 covers chairs plus a table. Multiply to price both chairs, then subtract that from the whole bill.
questions.questionZh: 2把椅子和1张桌子共售$50。1把椅子售价$8。桌子售价多少？
questions.hintZh: $50 包含椅子和桌子，先乘出 2 张椅子的价钱，再从总额中减去。

questions.question: 4 children have 5 buns each. Each child eats 2 buns. How many buns are there left?
questions.hint: Look at just 1 child: subtract the buns he consumes from the buns he holds, then multiply that leftover by the number of children.
questions.questionZh: 4名儿童每人有5个面包。他们每人吃了2个面包。还剩多少个面包？
questions.hintZh: 先只看 1 个孩子：用 5 个减去吃掉的 2 个，再乘以孩子的人数。

questions.question: Mrs Taylor has 10 boxes of egg tarts. There are 4 egg tarts in a box. She gives 6 boxes of egg tarts to her friends. How many egg tarts has Mrs Taylor left?
questions.hint: Whole boxes go away, not loose tarts, so subtract the boxes given away, then multiply the boxes she keeps by the tarts in a box.
questions.questionZh: 泰勒太太有10盒蛋挞，每盒有4个蛋挞。她给朋友6盒蛋挞。泰勒太太还剩多少个蛋挞？
questions.hintZh: 送走的是整盒，先减出她还剩几盒，再乘以每盒 4 个蛋挞。

questions.question: There are 7 bunches of balloons. Each bunch has 3 balloons. 15 of the balloons are green and the rest are blue. How many blue balloons are there?
questions.hint: Find the balloon total across all the bunches by multiplying, then take away the green balloons to leave the blue.
questions.questionZh: 有7束气球，每束有3个气球。其中15个气球是绿色，其余是蓝色。蓝色气球有多少个？
questions.hintZh: 先乘出 7 束一共多少个气球，再减去绿色的 15 个。

questions.question: A pencil costs 90 cents. An eraser costs 60 cents less. Jim wants to buy 3 erasers. How much does he have to pay?
questions.hint: The eraser price is not given directly, so subtract it out of the pencil price as your 1st move, then multiply for 3 erasers.
questions.questionZh: 铅笔售价90美分。橡皮擦便宜60美分。吉姆想买3块橡皮擦。他要付多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 橡皮的价钱没有直接给出，要先用铅笔的价钱减去 60 分，再乘以 3 块橡皮。

questions.question: Peter has $20. He buys a vase for $11. The cashier gives him a 5-dollar note and some 2-dollar notes in change. How many 2-dollar notes does the cashier give him?
questions.hint: Get Peter's change by subtracting the vase price, set the 5-dollar note aside, then split what remains into equal smaller notes.
questions.questionZh: 彼得有$20。他花$11买了花瓶。收银员找给他1张5美元钞票和若干张2美元钞票。收银员找给他多少张2美元钞票？
questions.hintZh: 先减出找回的钱，再拿掉那张 $5 纸币，剩下的钱按小面值平均分。

questions.question: Alice packs 12 buns equally into 3 bags. In each bag, there are 1 raisin bun and some butter buns. How many butter buns are there in each bag?
questions.hint: Divide the 12 buns equally among the bags before anything else, then take the raisin bun out of 1 bag's share.
questions.questionZh: 爱丽丝把12个面包平均装进3个袋子。每个袋子里有1个葡萄干面包和一些黄油面包。每个袋子里有多少个黄油面包？
questions.hintZh: 先把 12 个包子平均分到袋子里，再从 1 袋的份里减去 1 个葡萄干包。

questions.question: Mary has 12 apples. George has 6 apples. How many apples must Mary give to George so that they have an equal number of apples?
questions.hint: Fair sharing closes the gap from both sides. Subtract to find the gap, then hand over 1/2 of it.
questions.questionZh: 玛丽有12个苹果。乔治有6个苹果。玛丽必须给乔治多少个苹果，他们的苹果数才会相等？
questions.hintZh: 要变成一样多，先算出 2 人相差多少，再把这个差的 1/2 给出去。

questions.question: Daniel has 40 stickers. Kate has 22 stickers. How many stickers must Daniel give to Kate so that they have an equal number of stickers?
questions.hint: The difference between them gets shared, so subtract Kate's stickers from Daniel's, then divide that difference into 2 equal parts.
questions.questionZh: 丹尼尔有40张贴纸。凯特有22张贴纸。丹尼尔必须给凯特多少张贴纸，他们的贴纸数才会相等？
questions.hintZh: 相差的部分要平分，先用 Daniel 的贴纸减去 Kate 的，求出差，再把差平均分成 2 份。

questions.question: Peter has 90 cents in his wallet. He has 5 coins of 10 cents and some 20-cent coins. How many 20-cent coins does he have?
questions.hint: Work out what the 10-cent coins are worth altogether, subtract that from what is in the wallet, then see how many bigger coins make the rest.
questions.questionZh: 彼得的钱包里有90美分。他有5枚10美分硬币和一些20美分硬币。他有多少枚20美分硬币？
questions.hintZh: 先算出那些 10 分硬币一共多少钱，从钱包里的 90 分中减掉，再看剩下的钱能换几枚大面值硬币。

questions.question: There are 20 marbles in a bag. Sam divides them equally into 4 groups. How many marbles are there in 2 such groups?
questions.hint: Divide before you multiply: find the size of 1 group, then multiply that group size by the groups the question asks about.
questions.questionZh: 一个袋子里有20颗弹珠。萨姆把它们平均分成4组。2组这样的弹珠共有多少颗？
questions.hintZh: 先除后乘：先算出每组有几颗弹珠，再乘以题目问的组数。

questions.question: There are 6 oranges in a bag. 1 bag of oranges costs $3. Mrs Cook has $15. How many oranges can she buy altogether?
questions.hint: Divide her savings by the price of a bag to see how many bags she can afford, then multiply by the oranges packed in a bag.
questions.questionZh: 一袋有6个橙子。1袋橙子售价$3。库克太太有$15。她一共能买多少个橙子？
questions.hintZh: 先用 $15 除以每袋 $3,算出能买几袋，再乘以每袋 6 个橙子。

questions.question: Mrs Scott has some cookies. She buys 15 cookies. She has 65 cookies in the end. (a) How many cookies does she have at first? (b) How many cookies does she have altogether if she buys another 25 cookies?
questions.hint: (a) runs backwards: take the cookies she buys off her ending amount. (b) starts from that same ending amount and adds the extra 25.
questions.questionZh: 斯科特太太有一些饼干。她买了15块饼干，最后有65块饼干。(a) 开始时她有多少块饼干？(b) 如果她再买25块饼干，她一共有多少块饼干？
questions.hintZh: (a) 要倒着算：用最后的数量减去买来的 15 个。(b) 在最后的数量上再加 25 个。

questions.question: Mr Adam spends $70 on a belt and saves the rest of his money. If he saves $12, (a) how much more does he spend than save? (b) how much money does he have at first?
questions.hint: (a) asks how much bigger, so subtract the saved amount from the spent amount. (b) asks for everything he began with, so add those 2 parts instead.
questions.questionZh: 亚当先生花$70买了一条皮带，其余的钱存起来。如果他存了$12，(a) 他花的钱比存的钱多多少？(b) 开始时他有多少钱？
questions.hintZh: (a) 问多多少，用花掉的钱减去存下的钱。(b) 问原来有多少，把这 2 部分加起来。

questions.question: A plate costs $8 more than 1 bowl. If the plate costs $23, (a) how much does the bowl cost? (b) what is the total cost of the plate and the bowl?
questions.hint: The plate is the dearer item, so (a) subtracts the $8 gap from the plate price. (b) then adds the plate and the bowl together.
questions.questionZh: 盘子比1个碗贵$8。如果盘子售价$23，(a) 碗售价多少？(b) 盘子和碗一共多少钱？
questions.hintZh: 盘子比碗贵，(a) 用盘子的价钱减去相差的 $8。(b) 再把盘子和碗的价钱相加。

questions.question: There are 40 chickens and 13 ducks on a farm. The farmer buys another 14 chickens. (a) How many more chickens than ducks are there on the farm? (b) How many chickens and ducks are there altogether?
questions.hint: Update the chickens by adding the new arrivals before anything else. Use that fresh chicken number for (a), which subtracts the ducks, and for (b), which adds them.
questions.questionZh: 农场里有40只鸡和13只鸭。农夫又买了14只鸡。(a) 农场里的鸡比鸭多多少只？(b) 鸡和鸭一共有多少只？
questions.hintZh: 先把新买的 14 只加到鸡的数量上。(a) 用更新后的鸡数减去鸭数，(b) 用它加上鸭数。
